deals.title: Anker PowerExpand 8-in-1 USB-C Hub for $40 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: The Anker PowerExpand 8-in-1 USB-C hub is 26% off at Amazon. A single USB-C connection adds two HDMI ports, Ethernet, two USB-A ports, and an SD/microSD card reader to a laptop. On macOS, both external monitors show the same image. The charger is not included. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features USB-C port 2 USB-A data ports 2 HDMI ports ethernet port microSD/SD card reader up to 5Gbps transfer speed
